title_zh: 约定向平台提交重复评论线索供核查

scenario.label_zh: 约定向平台提交重复评论线索供核查
scenario.goal_zh: 区分重复文本与操纵评论结论，并约定提交评论链接、重复文本及日期而不猜测作者

context_zh: 虚构网上交易平台客服对话。顾客发现评论文本重复，希望平台核查，没有交易或真实商家指控。
author: author-phase11-b

sentences.speaker: Hassan
sentences.text: I'm a long-standing customer of this seller, but five recent reviews use exactly the same unusual paragraph.

sentences.speaker: Iris
sentences.text: Have you saved the review links on our marketplace?

sentences.speaker: Hassan
sentences.text: Yes. Is that proof of review manipulation?

sentences.speaker: Iris
sentences.text: It's a reason to investigate, not enough for me to make that finding. We would need to check how those reviews were submitted.

sentences.speaker: Hassan
sentences.text: What should I include in the report?

sentences.speaker: Iris
sentences.text: The links, the repeated text, and the dates you can see. Please separate those observations from any guess about who wrote them.

sentences.speaker: Hassan
sentences.text: I'll submit that evidence without claiming I know who is responsible.

sentences.speaker: Iris
sentences.text: Thank you. Our review team can assess it once you've submitted it.
